versions.subject: Update proc_creation_win_exfil_data_via_cli.yml
versions.detection:
selection_iwr:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
        - 'iwr '
        - 'wget '
        - 'curl '
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -ur' # Shortest possible version of the -uri flag
        - ' -me' # Shortest possible version of the -method flag
        - ' -b'
        - ' POST '
selection_curl:
    Image|endswith: '\curl.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '--ur' # Shortest possible version of the --uri flag
        - '-d' # Shortest possible version of the --data flag
payloads:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'ToBase64String'
        - 'whoami'
        - 'nltest'
        - 'type'
        - 'ifconfig'
        - 'hostname'
        - 'net view'
        - 'qprocess'
        - 'netstat'
        - 'systeminfo'
        - 'tasklist'
        - 'sc query'
condition: 1 of selection_* and payloads
versions.spl: (Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\cmd.exe") CommandLine IN ("*Invoke-WebRequest*", "*iwr *", "*wget *", "*curl *") CommandLine="* -ur*" CommandLine="* -me*" CommandLine="* -b*" CommandLine="* POST *") OR (Image="*\\curl.exe" CommandLine="*--ur*" CommandLine="*-d*") CommandLine IN ("*ToBase64String*", "*whoami*", "*nltest*", "*type*", "*ifconfig*", "*hostname*", "*net view*", "*qprocess*", "*netstat*", "*systeminfo*", "*tasklist*", "*sc query*")
